name: Secure Shredding Agent

transport.framing: one UTF-8 JSON line per connection

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check service health without touching file data

tools.name: inspect_target
tools.description: Inspect an eligible file without modifying it

tools.name: preview_shred
tools.description: Dry run; issue a single-use expiring confirmation token bound to the path and file fingerprint

tools.name: execute_shred
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: use only after explicit user confirmation of a preview. Overwrite one random pass, fsync, and unlink. Complete physical erasure is not guaranteed. Never automatically retry.

notes: No master shell, LLM, router, registry, or central dispatcher is implemented.
A token establishes protocol confirmation, not proof of human intent; future callers must obtain the user's explicit approval.
Same-UID socket access is required; do not expose this API over a network.
